target.title: fix: use fallback for structured invalid request errors
target.body:
Closes #99174

AI-assisted: yes (Codex).

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users routing through Anthropic-compatible providers could see a structured `invalid_request_error` payload treated as an unclassified embedded-runner failure, so model fallback would retry the same failing model instead of trying the configured fallback model when the provider rejected a request format.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing fallback classifier already treats known request-format failures as `format` fallback candidates, but the embedded-runner payload path only allowed a narrower set of provider error reasons through. This change recognizes structured provider `invalid_request` payloads after more specific auth/context/billing/rate-limit checks, then allows that `format` reason to propagate from embedded run error payloads.

## User Impact

Users with a fallback model configured should get the fallback attempt for structured provider request-format rejections instead of losing the turn after a same-model retry.

## Evidence
